Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original production identity mark for Astering, an ambitious open-source personal project, calendar, knowledge and AI-agent workspace.
Primary request: redesign a childish smiling yellow star as a sophisticated, highly artistic, memorable open-source technology identity. Retain the idea of records and actions becoming starlight and freedom to create. The symbol should be warm and alive through its contour, without a cartoon face.
Style/medium: exceptional contemporary identity design, custom optical geometry with organic calligraphic curves, flat vector-friendly silhouette. Art-directed and distinctive; designed as a symbol rather than an illustration. One solid deep luminous indigo color, approximately #6857D9. Strong black-and-white equivalent. Genuinely transparent canvas.
Composition/framing: one centered standalone symbol, square image, about 78 percent occupancy and generous equal padding. Clear at 16, 24 and 32px. Keep counters broad and strokes substantial.
Constraints: no words, letters written alongside the mark, text, mockup, presentation sheet, app tile, gradients, glow, shadow, metallic effects, 3D, outline stroke, face, blush, character eyes, tiny orbiting stars, background stars, watermark or signature. No checkmarks. Do not resemble the OpenAI interlocking six-loop knot, Google Gemini sparkle, Claude asterisk, Vercel triangle, or any existing logo. Deliver one final emblem, not multiple proposals.
Concept: STELLAR LIGATURE. A sculptural, flowing ribbon-like glyph which reads first as an ascending stellar flare, and only on a second look as a capital A. Two broad asymmetric curved strokes join into a single compelling silhouette, with a generous luminous negative-space opening at its heart. An energetic tapered terminal and one carefully balanced counter create a subtle stellar impression. The geometry is elegant and unexpected, slightly humanist, never a generic triangle with a star pasted onto it. No literal isolated letter A. One coherent continuous body.

A single connected silhouette, compact and balanced, with two generous expressive sweeping wings and an elegant central upward point. A single bold star-like negative-space cut suggests the living spark at the heart, without eyes, a smile, antennae or decorative details. Powerful iconic silhouette and broad solid masses; the contours themselves carry all expression.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final transparent original Astering brand mark.
Input image: edit target, the five-lobed indigo Astering aperture concept.
Primary request: refine this exact five-lobed stellar aperture into a sophisticated, tender organic identity. Preserve the recognizable clockwise five-lobed structure and the large star-shaped central negative-space aperture. Change the five harsh hook / blade / shuriken-like outer tips into graceful gently rounded petal-like terminals. Keep controlled optical geometry, broad solid lobes and enough negative space to read at 16px. The outer contour should feel like a living stellar blossom opening, not a throwing star or fan.
Style: one perfectly flat solid indigo #6857D9, exact clean smooth alpha edges, absolutely no texture or shading. Replace all existing translucent scattered blue specks around the silhouette and inside the central aperture with fully transparent pixels. Central star hole remains genuinely transparent, never filled black or white.
Framing: square canvas, perfectly centered, fits inside 78% of the width and height, equal generous transparent padding. Full self-contained mark with no cropping.
Constraints: one connected silhouette. Five lobes, five-pointed central star hole. No new detached shapes, extra stars, words, lettering, eyes, face, rim, gradients, highlights, blur, glow, shadow, outline stroke, 3D or background. Do not become an interwoven knot or a four-point sparkle. This is final logo art, not a presentation or comparison sheet.

production.method: Technical vector tracing of the selected refined raster alpha: alpha threshold 128, Potrace 1.16 (--flat --turdsize 64 --alphamax 1 --opttolerance 0.6), SVGO 3.3.5 multipass, shared currentColor path. The SVG was not generated directly by imagegen.
production.avatar_method: Native SVG composition of the identical symbol path at scale 0.88, centered on a restrained night-blue radial gradient. astering-avatar.png is rendered from this SVG with Sharp; no separate AI redraw.
